name: Lianne
title: Edexcel A-level Economics tutor and former Edexcel examiner
bio: Lianne taught A-level Economics for over twenty years in an Ofsted-rated outstanding school, where she was Head of Department, and in an outstanding sixth-form college.

She has been an examiner for Edexcel A-level Economics and A-level Business, so her lessons are built around what the mark schemes actually reward: the chains of reasoning and diagrams that take a 25-marker into Level 4, how to use the extracts for the application marks in Section B, and the Section A technique that stops the easy marks leaking away.
Each session covers the topic in full, then real past-paper questions which she marks against the Edexcel levels grids and goes over with you.
offers: One-to-one online sessions for Year 12 and Year 13, at a regular weekly slot
Essay and data-response marking with examiner-style written feedback
Mock-paper walk-throughs before the May and June exams
